comparison.objective: Candidate commissions and locks a stationary axis damper; record hangs two parts on separate continuously moving conveyor hooks before deadlines.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests recessed tool engagement, fine collar adjustment, locking torque, and repeated physical cycling. Record tests timed interception, moving-target loop-over-hook alignment, release, and coordination across successive hooks.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate needs two safe repeatable impacts without bottoming or drift. Record needs each part freely supported on its own hook for the final second before crossing the mark, with clearance from robot/other part and no hook delay beyond 0.2 s.
comparison.reason: Moving-target threading under conveyor timing is materially different from static adjustment followed by dynamic commissioning. The candidate lacks exact drift/rebound/overload limits; the record does specify timing, clearance, and support thresholds, so ambiguity is not plausible.
